answer: Shards are assigned from the lotus graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The shale assignment is published and nebula records each panel. The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1930 identities would post 4560 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
